blocks.text: Computer networks ko un ke size aur coverage area (kitne ilaqe tak phailte hain) ki bunyad par qismon mein baanta jata hai. Mukhtalif qism ke networks mukhtalif kaamon ke liye istemal hote hain. Har qism devices ko apne khaas tareeqe se jorti hai. Sab se aam qismein LAN, WAN aur Internet (Public WAN) hain. Yeh networks baat-cheet aur data share karne mein madad dete hain. Network ki qismein samajhne se sahi network chunne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Computer networks ko faasle (distance) aur coverage area ki bunyad par qismon mein baanta jata hai.

Local Area Network chhote ilaqe ke andar devices ko jorta hai (jaise Figure 1.3 mein). Yeh ilaqa ghar, school ya daftar ho sakta hai. LAN mein data bohat tezi se jata hai. Aam taur par LAN ek hi idare (organization) ki milkiyat hota hai aur wahi use chalata hai. LAN mein aam taur par Ethernet aur Wi-Fi istemal hote hain. LAN sasta (cost-effective) hai aur use sambhalna aasan hai.

blocks.alt: LAN ke nishan wala khula ghar: deewar par teen antenna wala router cable se mez par rakhe desktop aur laptop, deewar par tablet aur farsh par doosre router se jura hai; farsh wala router printer se cable aur tablet se Wi-Fi se jura hai. Almari par TV rakha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.3: Local Area Network (LAN) (kitab ki Figure 1.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Wide Area Network bara jughrafiyai ilaqa (geographic area) cover karta hai (jaise Figure 1.4 mein). Yeh mukhtalif shehron ya mulkon ke networks ko jorta hai. WAN leased lines (kiraye par li gayi khaas lines), satellites ya Internet istemal karta hai. Is mein data LAN se aahista jata hai. WAN lagana aur chalana mehnga hai. Internet WAN ki sab se bari misaal hai.

blocks.alt: WAN ka nishan; Internet likhe teen badal tooti lakeeron se jure hain, aur har badal aik jagah ke Wi-Fi router se jura hai: computers aur phone wale do ghar, aur desktop computer wali daftar ki imarat.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.4: Wide Area Network (WAN) (kitab ki Figure 1.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Internet poori duniya ka network hai jo karoron devices ko jorta hai. Is se poori duniya mein maloomat share hoti hain. Email, websites aur cloud storage jaisi services Internet istemal karti hain (jaise Figure 1.5 mein). Internet baat-cheet ke liye standard protocols (sab ke maane hue qawaid) istemal karta hai. Internet taleem, karobar aur tafreeh (entertainment) mein madad deta hai. Rozana zindagi mein is ka bara kirdar hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein globe (duniya ka gola), jo lakeeron se charon taraf ke devices se jura hai: do desktop computers, laptop, router, printer, server aur Wi-Fi ke nishan wale kai badal; kuch devices aapas mein bhi jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Internet (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba un services ki fehrist banayein jo Internet istemal karti hain. Internet ki ahmiyat par baat karein.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text:
• DSL (Digital Subscriber Line): telephone lines ke zariye Internet; is mein ek hi waqt mein call aur browsing dono ho sakti hain.
• ISP (Internet Service Provider): woh company jo logon ko Internet deti hai.

blocks.prompt: LAN kya hai? WAN se is ka aik farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: LAN chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school ya daftar, mein devices jorta hai. WAN ke baraks, jo shehar ya mulk dhanpta hai, yeh tez, sasta aur aam taur par aik idare ki milkiyat hota hai.

items: LAN: chhota ilaqa (ghar, school, daftar), tez, sasta, ek idare ka.
WAN: shehar ya mulk; leased lines, satellites ya Internet; aahista aur mehnga.
Internet: sab se bara WAN, poori duniya ka public network.
